prompt: The tickets/ directory holds two hundred and forty customer-support tickets. Exactly one of them is a customer asking to cancel their subscription - to end the plan and stop being billed. Every other ticket mentions cancelling in some other sense. Find that one ticket and write just its id (the file name without .txt) to answer.txt.
check: test "$(tr -d ' \n' < answer.txt | sed 's#^tickets/##; s#\.txt$##' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')" = TK-1966 && if [ -n "$ARNES_SESSION_ID" ]; then grep "\"parentSessionId\":\"$ARNES_SESSION_ID\"" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; else tail -n "+$(( $(cat .runs-before) + 1 ))" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; fi
